limitations: This report covers LibreOffice Impress 26.8.0.3 on macOS 26.0 Apple Silicon only; it does not establish PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides parity.

The report does not claim interactive Office editing or a real-device test. Re-run the exact commands after renderer, theme, fixture, or viewer-version changes.
